claim: severity_reason: "The Google profile carries no website at all, so nothing public states services, hours or accepted insurance"
problem: Contradicted by sources the auditor itself cites. BizArchive publicly lists hours (Mon 9-7, Tue/Wed 9-6, Thu 9-7, Fri 9-6, Sat 9-2, Sun closed) and Birdeye lists hours (Mon 9-7, Tue-Thu 9-6, Sat 9-2). Hours are stated publicly; what is missing is a practice-controlled website.
fix: Reword to: "no website the practice controls states services, hours or accepted insurance; hours appear only on third-party listings such as BizArchive and Birdeye, which the practice does not manage."

claim: fix_steps step 4: rebuild a site with "accepted insurance (including Medicaid/Medicare Advantage plans)"
problem: Not found in any source. The archived insurances page lists Delta Dental, Aetna, Metlife, Cigna, Horizon, United Healthcare, DentaQuest, Guardian and CareCredit; Medicaid and Medicare Advantage are not mentioned anywhere. As written it implies the practice accepts those plans.
fix: Change to "...and say whether you accept Medicaid or Medicare Advantage plans" so the report does not assert plans the practice may not take.

claim: likely_cause and audit_md: the practice's own site was live "through December 2022" (parking lander "by October 2023")
problem: Understated. The Wayback CDX index shows 200 captures of the live practice site on 2023-04-05 and 2023-06-07 (the June capture is titled "Crystal Smiles - Your Smile is our Top Priority"); only the 2023-10-31 capture is the GoDaddy parking lander. "Through December 2022" reads as if the site stopped then.
fix: Say "through June 2023, and already a parking lander by 31 October 2023" and cite the CDX/capture URLs.

claim: crystalsmilesnj.com result: "the page served was a Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' bot check"
problem: Quoted wording is not on the page. Live today the challenge reads "Performing security verification ... verifies you are not a bot" with tab title "Just a moment...". The substance (Cloudflare bot check) is correct; the quote is not verbatim.
fix: Quote what is actually shown, or drop the quotation marks: "a Cloudflare bot-verification page".

claim: Google Business Profile cited as https://www.google.com/maps/place/Crystal+Smiles+LLC/@40.4203647,-74.3791392,17z (rescue.json links_to_broken_domain, after_fix, founder_md Sources)
problem: The URL does not resolve to the business. Opened in Chrome it rewrites to /place// and shows only the base map with Directions, Save, Nearby, Send to phone and Share - no name, address, phone or rating. A reader (including the owner) cannot reach the claimed details from this link; the profile is only reached by searching the name.
fix: Cite a link that resolves, e.g. https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Crystal+Smiles+LLC+65+Rues+Ln+East+Brunswick+NJ, or a place-ID permalink copied from the profile's Share dialog.

claim: after_fix: "about 150 public reviews (4.8 on Google, 4.4 on Birdeye)"
problem: Only half verified. Birdeye shows 4.4 / 155 reviews; Google shows 4.8 but its review count was not visible (Google served a 'limited view' of Maps, as the caveats say), so the combined figure is not sourced.
fix: Write "155 reviews on Birdeye (4.4/5); Google shows 4.8 but its review count was not visible" and keep the enquiry-volume point explicitly labelled as an inference.

claim: screenshot_files (six shot-*.png) referenced in domains and offered to the owner in founder_md
problem: None of the named files are present in the shared folder, so the screenshots behind those claims could not be checked; founder_md promises to send them.
fix: Confirm the six files exist and are attached (or drop the promise) before the email is used.
